checked_claims.claim: Proposed locking design guarantees atomic upload decisions
checked_claims.reason: Proposed dataclass is not frozen, two dictionary writes are not atomic for unlocked readers, and cache/lock keys omit remote and force; current parallel flow splits package lists.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Current UploadUpstreamChecker decides upload/force_upload from remote revision existence: missing -> (True,False), present with force -> (True,True), otherwise (False,False) (conan/internal/api/uploader.py:39-80). The upload API parallelizes split package lists (conan/api/subapi/upload.py:131-140). For a redesign, workers should return an immutable decision keyed by remote plus exact revision and force policy, then one coordinator should publish both flags after completion. If shared mutable decisions remain, all readers and writers must use the same lock. A local lock cannot make remote existence and subsequent upload atomic; that requires server-side conditional semantics. These are design recommendations, not features demonstrated by the current checker.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: _get_pc_variables normalizes the prefix, formats each lib/include/bin directory, merges their dictionaries, and applies custom entries (conan/tools/gnu/pkgconfigdeps.py:107-149). For d directories of bounded average path length m, this work is approximately O(d*m) plus prefix and custom-content processing, assuming ordinary dictionary operations. The three update calls add linear work in inserted entries, not a multiplicative dependency factor. Costs accumulate across calls for packages/components; this source does not establish a performance bottleneck or large measured constants.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The builder processes pending requirements depth-first and skips entries marked override (conan/internal/graph/graph_builder.py:47-62). For expanded requirements it checks downstream state, applies force/override precedence or checks version conflicts (71-98). check_downstream_exists can recurse toward dependants, while propagate_downstream updates transitive state and may scan edges (conan/internal/graph/graph.py:116-172,174-214). More edges, deeper chains and diamond reconciliation can add work, but this code and a fixed regression test do not establish the claimed quadratic bound, hash-collision pathology, or numerical traversal estimates.
